parsed.name: LabRAD异步客户端
parsed.description: 这是一个用于实验室自动化系统中与远程 LabRAD 服务器通信的软件客户端组件。它支持异步连接、创建通信上下文、构建并发送请求或数据包、发送消息，以及管理监听器和断开连接事件，常用于实验控制网络中的服务访问与消息交互。
parsed.description_en: This is a software client component for communicating with remote LabRAD servers in laboratory automation systems. It supports asynchronous connections, creation of communication contexts, building and sending requests or packets, sending messages, and managing listeners and disconnect events, and is commonly used for service access and message exchange in experiment-control networks.
